guia.what: A divider line that separates content, horizontally or vertically, with an optional label in the middle. It’s the same separator that structures the sections of these docs.
whenUse: Two neighboring blocks cover different things, and spacing alone isn’t enough.
You want to mark the break between long sections of a page.
You need a label in the middle of the break (“or,” “More options”).
whenAvoid: More breathing room between blocks is enough → `stack` with a larger `gap`.
Each block already has its own surface → `card`.
dos: Use it between sections, not between every pair of elements.
If it’s purely decorative, give it `role="none"` so it doesn’t clutter the accessibility tree.
donts: Don’t draw lines everywhere. Rhythm comes from spacing; a line is the exception.
